Name: Custom Wallpaper Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This framework lets modders create wide and hi-res wallpaper using Content Patcher.

Wallpaper should first be added to the catalogue using [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Migrate_to_Stardew_Valley_1.5.5#In_the_furniture_catalogue]the game's built-in custom wallpaper system[/url].

To implement this mod, create a Content Patcher patch targeting this mod's dictionary, e.g.:

[code]{
    "Action": "EditData",
    "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperFramework/dictionary",
    "Entries": {
        "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide": {
            "id": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide",
            "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide/Wallpaper",
            "width": 12
        },
        "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide2": {
            "id": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide2",
            "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide/Wallpaper2",
            "width": 2
        },
        "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide3": {
            "id": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide3",
            "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide/Wallpaper3",
            "width": 8
        },
        "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide4": {
            "id": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide4",
            "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide/Wallpaper4",
            "width": 5,
            "scale":2
        },
        "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide5": {
            "id": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide5",
            "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CustomWallpaperWide/Wallpaper5",
            "width": 6,
            "scale":1
        }
    }
}
[/code]
[b]id[/b] must refer to the id of your wallpaper added using the game's custom wallpaper system.
[b]width[/b] refers to the number of tiles wide the wallpaper is. Wallpaper is always 3 tiles high.
[b]scale[/b] is the size multiplier used when displaying the wallpaper, so a scale of 4 means your wallpaper will be scaled up 4x (this is the default). If you want higher-resolution wallpaper, you can set the scale to 2 or 1.  Your texture file size must reflect this, so if your scale is 4, the texture must be 48 pixels tall (3 * 64 / 4), etc.
[b]texturePath[/b] must be a path in the game's Content folder (usually a fake path using Content Patcher to load an actual png file).

An example pack is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12534]here[/url].



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
